label: Order
caption: Order of the Court
text: IT IS ORDERED that the revised Rules of this Court, approved by the Court and lodged with the Clerk, shall be effective March 16, 2026, and that the amended provisions shall be printed as an appendix to the United States Reports. IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that the Rules promulgated December 5, 2022, see 598 U.S. ___, shall be rescinded as of March 15, 2026, and that the revised Rules shall govern all proceedings after their effective date except to the extent that, in the opinion of the Court, their application to a pending matter would not be feasible or would work an injustice, in which event the former procedure applies.
